Teklif alınan kategori

<script id="egeser-category-offer-context">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  var offer = document.getElementById('eg-category-offer');
  if (!offer) return;

  var form = offer.querySelector('.js-egeser-lead-form');
  if (!form) return;

  var productId = form.querySelector('input[name="product_id"]');
  var productName = form.querySelector('input[name="product_name"]');
  var source = form.querySelector('input[name="source"]');
  var title = document.getElementById('eg-category-offer-title');
  var context = document.getElementById('eg-category-offer-context');
  var contextLabel = document.getElementById('eg-category-offer-context-label');
  var contextName = document.getElementById('eg-category-offer-context-name');
  var categoryName = context ? (context.getAttribute('data-category-name') || '') : '';

  function setGeneric(){
    if (productId) productId.value = '0';
    if (productName) productName.value = '';
    if (source) source.value = categoryName || 'Kategori';
    if (title) title.textContent = 'Bu kategori için projenize özel teklif alın.';
    if (contextLabel) contextLabel.textContent = 'Teklif alınan kategori';
    if (contextName) contextName.textContent = categoryName;
    if (context) context.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Teklif alınan kategori');
  }

  function setProduct(link){
    var id = link.getAttribute('data-product-id') || '0';
    var name = link.getAttribute('data-product-name') || '';
    if (!name) { setGeneric(); return; }
    if (productId) productId.value = id;
    if (productName) productName.value = name;
    if (source) source.value = name + (categoryName ? ' | ' + categoryName : '');
    if (title) title.textContent = name + ' için projenize özel teklif alın.';
    if (contextLabel) contextLabel.textContent = 'Teklif alınan model';
    if (contextName) contextName.textContent = name;
    if (context) context.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Teklif alınan model');
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function(event){
    var node = event.target;
    while (node && node !== document) {
      if (node.tagName === 'A' && node.getAttribute('href') === '#eg-category-offer') {
        if (node.getAttribute('data-product-name')) setProduct(node);
        else setGeneric();
        break;
      }
      node = node.parentNode;
    }
  }, false);
})();
</script>
